arabic text: YA RAB KOI MASOOMA ZINDAAN MAY NA TANHA HO
english translation text: OH LORD! MAY NO INNOCENT CHILD EVER BE ALONE IN A PRISON

arabic text: YA RAB KOI MASOOMA ZINDAAN MAY NA TANHA HO\nPABAND NA HO AAHEIN, RONAY PE NA PEHRA HO
english translation text: OH LORD, MAY NO INNOCENT CHILD EVER BE ALONE IN A PRISON,\nMAY THE CHILD NOT BE STOPPED FROM CRYING WHILE REMEMBERING HER LOVED ONES

arabic text: THI JIS KO NEEND AATI SHABBIR KE SEENE PAR\nZINDAAN DARE ZINDAAN, USKE LIYE KAZAA HO
english translation text: THE ONE WHO USED TO SLEEP ON HUSAIN'S CHEST,\nTO BE ALIVE IN A PRISON, IS LIKE DEATH FOR HER

arabic text: ZINDAANO SE AATI THI AWAAZ SISAKNAY KI\nJAISE KE SAKINA KO, HAR ZINDAAN RO RAHA HO
english translation text: THE SOUNDS OF CRYING USED TO COME FROM THE PRISONS,\nAS IF EVERY PRISON WAS CRYING FOR SAKINA

arabic text: TAKRAYE NA WO KYON KAR ZINDAAN KI DIWAARO SE\nBHAI SE AUR PHUPHI SE, JISKO JUDA KIYA HO
english translation text: WHY SHOULD SHE NOT THROW HERSELF AGAINST THE WALLS OF THE PRISON,\nWHEN SHE HAS BEEN SEPARATED FROM HER BROTHER AND AUNT

arabic text: ZINDAAN MAY AHMAD BHI YAAD AAYI SAKINA KI\nDIL RORO KEH RAHA HAI, AB NA UJAALA HO
english translation text: WHEN I REMEMBER SAKINA IN THE PRISON, MY HEART\nCRIES AND SAYS, LET THERE BE NO MORE LIGHT
